mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month, and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY combined with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% YoY signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% YoY, and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening of financial conditions, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 1 month during a tightening cycle and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
